# Trett Labs

> Trett Labs Limited is a UK software company (registered in England and Wales, company number 17310137; Mirfield, West Yorkshire; director Lee Trett) that builds and runs its own products.

- [Beequation and Beequation Kids](https://beequation.com/): mental maths puzzle apps for adults and for children aged 5 to 12, coming soon to iPhone and Android
- CoAmi: AI-built custom business software (in development)
- WikiBets: a betting comparison service for adults aged 18 and over (in development)
- Contact: hello@trettlabs.com
